description: Land Acquisition - Walala, Pathadumbara D/S Division, Kandy District
categorisation: This gazette notice is exclusively about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act. It describes a specific land parcel being acquired for public purpose, provides detailed land description (lot number, extent, boundaries, survey plan), lists claimants, and outlines the compensation claim process. This fits perfectly within the Land Gazette category (Type 4) as it deals with land acquisition matters without any government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
